scope: Numerical evidence, explicit scientific qualifications and ordinary document safety; no writing-quality evaluation.

definitions.label: support/opposition direction
definitions.definition: The linear direction in activation space fitted to separate Supports from Opposes examples.

definitions.label: difference in means
definitions.definition: The fitting method for the support/opposition direction: mean activation of Supports minus mean activation of Opposes, normalized.

definitions.label: logistic activation probe
definitions.definition: An L2-regularized linear classifier fitted on the same activations as the support/opposition direction.

definitions.label: model answer margin
definitions.definition: The model's own semantic Supports-minus-Opposes candidate log-probability margin.

definitions.label: frozen MiniLM comparator
definitions.definition: A logistic classifier over MiniLM embeddings of the situation and the consideration plus their elementwise product and absolute difference. It sees text only, never activations.

definitions.label: checkerboard
definitions.definition: A two-situation, two-consideration design where each consideration flips from Supports to Opposes across situations.

definitions.label: checkerboard interaction
definitions.definition: The standardized difference-in-differences over the four cells of a checkerboard. Zero for any score additive in situation and consideration.

definitions.label: standardized separation
definitions.definition: A True-minus-False mean difference measured in training-projection standard deviations, averaged over eight training partitions.

definitions.label: deterministic random item scores
definitions.definition: A baseline that hashes each item identifier to a scalar in [0, 1) and scores the item with it. It is a scalar per item, not a direction in activation space.

definitions.label: held-out answer template
definitions.definition: An answer format not seen during fitting, used to test whether a result survives a change of answer surface form.

definitions.label: situation-level label flip
definitions.definition: The permutation null: each training situation independently keeps or reverses all of its labels.

definitions.label: pilot train split
definitions.definition: The 1,500-row split on which probes are fitted.

definitions.label: pilot select split
definitions.definition: The 300-row / 75-checkerboard split on which the layer and the standardization constants are chosen.

definitions.label: pilot evaluation split
definitions.definition: The 500-row / 125-checkerboard split on which every reported metric is computed.

definitions.label: development evidence
definitions.definition: Evidence obtained while building and checking the experiment. Distinct from the audited confirmatory result.

definitions.label: strict test set
definitions.definition: The 7,394-row split held out on both the situation and the consideration-cluster axis. Untouched by every figure in this set.

definitions.label: dyadic-robust standard error
definitions.definition: The frozen standard error from which the 95% normal confidence intervals on M1 checkerboard interaction estimates are built.
